title: location_report
description: See docs/location.md. A device on the hub path (parental controls or the effective rule control_path hub) reports its position to the hub; only at home, where the hub is reachable. Devices off the hub path use the action <ns>.report_location with their key (home and away) and get not_hub_controlled here. The hub checks the effective rule location (off/not applicable → location_not_allowed, background fix with foreground → location_background_not_allowed), at most one report per 5 s, then hands the fix to the integration (client_location → device_tracker) without keeping it. Answer location_report_ok or location_report_error. REST twin without a socket: POST /api/client/location.

background.description: Fix taken while the app was not in the foreground.

location_shared.description: What the app shares now (optional, like client_status.location_shared).
